text:
Paul Cotter has 66 hits in 20 games for Vancouver, and that's the part of his game that gets noticed. Daniel Wagner of Pass it to Bulis wrote that Justin Williams "made a big deal about Paul Cotter throwing a bunch of hits," then added: "The Flyers are earning their ice against him so far."

That tension is the story. At five-on-five Vancouver has only 28.7% of the expected goals (the quality of chances) with him on the ice, 14.5 points worse than without him, and Evolving-Hockey saw a similar pattern last season in New Jersey (bottom 8% of forwards at creating offense). His 8 points (4 goals) lean on a 30.8% shooting rate on just 13 shots, far above our range for him. The recent run shows it: one point and no goals in his last ten games, with his ice time down more than two minutes a night. He brings speed (61 bursts over 20 mph, 94th percentile on NHL EDGE) and a 2023 Cup ring from Vegas, but his place in the lineup depends on the shot share moving.
headline: Paul Cotter's hits pile up while the shot share sinks
